goal: Implement repair-stage and business-obligation decision context construction, with bounded exploration and original-candidate failure memory, on existing storage and send boundaries.
findings: repair_relevance uses only registered evidence anchors; before a diagnosis it can omit earlier log and cross-file reads despite available budget.
Changing diagnosis and obligation IDs can omit the prior actual failed candidate check, encouraging repeated behavior-breaking repairs.
Context storage and skills alone are standard harness features; the candidate contribution is their effect on evidence selection, preserving behavior and correcting failed repairs, still unmeasured.
The user clarified that context means organization, storage and per-decision construction, not just history cropping; the existing flat panel needed a repair-specific construction layer.
changes: New explicit repair_frontier preserves both historical selectors and profile serialization. Exploration cap is frozen only for the new selector.

Latest fault-log group is necessary. Unabsorbed log pages/source/search reads are optional, deduplicated and selected by subject diversity then recency below contradictions and direct evidence within the same byte budget.

Last actual fail and original candidate registration remain across diagnosis changes. Panel preserves original IDs/check scope, unknown causal relevance and current-candidate distinction; it does not create new diagnosis facts or feedback links.
Only an actual pass with the original check protocol and evidence level clears the latest failure. Unknown and incompatible results do not.

Counterexamples cover initial cross-file exploration, new observations after diagnosis, two log pages, exploration cap/common bytes, changed root/obligations, bounded failure history, incompatible pass and frozen serialization.

New pure repair_context_layout compiler replaces the flat packet with a stage decision board, full semantic records split by authority and obligation kind, original reference relationships and actual tool readback hints. No new database, runtime or model calls.

All original record fields remain visible. Canonical roundtrip must equal the original solver projection before saving a plan or reserving a call; phase suggestions grant neither tool authority nor repair acceptance.

Pure fixtures cover alternatives, unknowns, check/draft priority, original failure versions and complete projection roundtrip. A Mock SDK/wire/completed-resume fixture is written, but not executed. Demo explicitly freezes repair_frontier and decision_layers.

Owner design, contracts, metrics, blueprint and source registry explain storage layers, construction and same-budget comparison. Public-source reading covers Anthropic context engineering, official Deep Agents context/memory and ACE; it is design borrowing, not method reproduction.

review.cross_review: performed; narrow compiler/wire review found no new static blocker, not runtime certification
corrected_before_commit: The byte-budget counterexample must use the same solver projection as its observed view.
Earlier nonduplicate log pages also require bounded exploration selection.
Use the compiler as a replacement, retain every original field and reject a roundtrip that drops a business obligation.

execution_boundary.user_instruction: Finish source first; tests later; stop spending time on inaccessible old tmp directories.

limits: No repair success, root accuracy, Token savings or paper novelty conclusion follows from source and counterexample design; the new layout may add bytes.
The new wire fixture does not enable applicability tools and cannot alone certify their visibility chain.
Thinking protocol remains full-history only. Frontier comparison requires an explicitly compatible mode with identical budgets in all groups.
Independent experience queries still accumulate complete required guidance; the selector stops when required content exceeds its limit.
Package A and B are unaccepted until managed software checks and actual CLI/SDK whole-chain verification pass.
